# The future doesn't need another cloud.It needs every cloud, connected

From powering enterprise AI to protecting data sovereignty, your clouds, data and AI workloads must
work as one—privately, at scale and free from lock-in.

[Explore Connectivity Solutions][57][Talk to Equinix][58]

## Enterprise AI is distributed everywhere.That's why you need Equinix.

The global infrastructure that connects your clouds, your data and your AI. Everywhere it runs.

[Explore Distributed AI][59][Talk to an expert][60]
AI demands more than a single cloud

Enterprise AI spans clouds, platforms and data. Equinix connects them so AI can run faster, better
and smarter.

AI runs where data lives

Equinix data centers unite clouds, networks and SaaS in one global ecosystem. Putting your AI closer
to the data and the compute it needs.

Sovereignty is non-negotiable

Keep data where regulations demand while scaling across clouds, partners and markets. All from one
unified platform.

Intelligence can't wait

The unequaled proximity of Equinix data centers put AI within milliseconds of the data and compute
it needs to scale.

# Where enterprise AI runs and outcomes scale.

## The trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference
## and agents in production.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to
deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that
regulated and mission-critical environments demand.

[ Talk to an Expert ][117] [ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][118]

## Introducing our AI operating framework

Palantir has named Rackspace a preferred partner to deploy and operate Foundry and AIP for
regulated, sovereign and private cloud environments.

[ Read the Press Release ][119] [ Explore the Partnership ][120]
[Rackspace Palantir]
[Enterprise AI Cloud]

## Rackspace is the operator of the full enterprise AI stack.

### One partner. Full accountability.

We assemble, integrate and operate the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and
agents in production, and remain accountable for outcomes long after deployment is complete.

#### Curated partners across every layer of the stack.

We have assembled best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform
and infrastructure into a governed system, purpose-built for enterprise AI in regulated
environments.

#### Governance built in. Not bolted on.

Security, compliance, data sovereignty and uptime are foundational to every enterprise AI cloud we
operate, especially in regulated and high-stakes environments.

#### Forward deployed engineers who build, run and scale

Our engineers embed directly in your environment to build, operationalize and run enterprise AI,
turning use cases into production systems and scaling them over time.

[ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][121]

## Enterprise AI Cloud Partner Ecosystem

We have curated best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack. Our ecosystem is deliberate,
opinionated and selected for how partners integrate across the stack and how they perform within it.
Everything is stitched together and governed as one system, so you can focus on outcomes instead of
managing complexity.

[AMD][VMware by Broadcom][Palantir][UNIPHORE][Rubrik][Dell Technologies]
[Explore our Ecosystem][122]
[Seattle Children's Logo]

> “We partnered with Rackspace because of Fanatical Experience® and their ability to provide an
> infrastructure to a guaranteed uptime of 99.999%, which means that our clinicians would have
> secure access to our EMR around the clock at the point of care.”

Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer,
Seattle Children’s Hospital [ See the case study ][123]

[See more case studies][124]

## 25+ years of experience operating mission-critical infrastructure. We’re built to run what comes
## next.

From infrastructure to enterprise AI in production, our depth shows up in the certification our
engineers hold, the platforms we’re qualified to operated and the environments we’ve kept running
for the industries that trust us with their most critical systems.

2,200+ certified technical experts
10,000+ technical certifications
600+ AI platform certifications
39 data centers globally

## Industry-Recognized Leadership

Independently recognized by the leading analysts who cover enterprise infrastructure and AI.

[Forrester][Gartner][IDC][ISG]

## Ready to operationalize AI?

Let's explore your use cases and build the full-stack foundation for real outcomes.

[ Get Started ][125]

# 2AI-DC
# INTEGRATORS

2AI-DC Integrators is a premier consulting and strategic advisory firm specializing exclusively in
hyperscale and AI-centric data center development.

## About 2AI-DC

### OUR COMPANY

With a technical leadership team that literally wrote the industry standards as founding members of
ASHRAE TC9.9, our multidisciplinary teams deliver world-class solutions across the full project
lifecycle, from initial site feasibility and strategic planning through commissioning and
operational readiness.

We bring unparalleled expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, supporting global hyperscalers,
wholesale colocation providers, retail colocation operators, and enterprise customers with
integrated services that de-risk decision-making and accelerate site-to-hyperscale readiness.

Our proven track record includes delivering next-generation data center prototypes and establishing
the technical frameworks that define excellence in the industry today.

## Our Mission

Our mission is to empower data center developers and operators with the technical expertise,
strategic insight, and integrated design solutions needed to build the world's most advanced AI and
high-performance computing infrastructure.

We are committed to delivering projects on time, on budget, and to specification while upholding the
highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability. By serving as a seamless extension of our
clients' teams, we protect their interests at every stage.

## Our Vision

We envision a future where data center infrastructure seamlessly supports humanity's most ambitious
technological advances, enabling AI breakthroughs that solve global challenges and drive
unprecedented innovation.

As the trusted advisor and technical partner to the world's leading technology companies and
infrastructure developers, we aim to set the gold standard for data center design, sustainability,
and operational efficiency.

[Our Vision]

#### Technical & Advisory Services

We provide comprehensive site diligence, development feasibility analysis, and strategic planning
for AI and HPC infrastructure, including confidential pitch deck development and
principal-to-principal negotiation support that accelerates your path from site identification to
hyperscale readiness.

[Master Planning & Entitlement Strategy]

#### Master Planning & Entitlement Strategy

Developing campus-scale master plans and navigate the complex entitlement process, coordinating
zoning analysis, stakeholder engagement, permitting timelines, and regulatory approvals to ensure
your data center development moves forward efficiently and securely through all jurisdictional
requirements.

[Data Center Expert AEC Design Services]

#### Data Center Expert AEC Design Services

Our multidisciplinary design and engineering teams deliver optimized, standards-compliant data
center solutions across architecture, civil, structural, MEP/FP, and ICT engineering, backed by the
industry experts who literally wrote the book on establishing modern data center design criteria.

[Owner's Representation Services]

#### Owner's Representation Services

We act as your trusted extension on-site, managing schedule, budget, quality, and contractor
coordination throughout data center construction to ensure your project is delivered on time, on
budget, and to Owner's specification, with real-time visibility and executive-level reporting,
ensuring delivery aligns with project objectives.

[Construction Administration & Quality Assurance]

#### Construction Administration & Quality Assurance

RFI reviews, milestone inspections, punch list management, and change order coordination, ensuring

## At Access Electric Supply, we take pride in finding uncommon solutions to complex electrical
## problems.

Since 1991, Access Electric Supply has challenged the way electrical distribution is done. In an
industry where extended lead times and limited options are often treated as unavoidable, we’ve built
our business on proving otherwise.

We leverage deep industry expertise, strategic manufacturer relationships, and creative sourcing
strategies to deliver comprehensive electrical distribution solutions with shorter, more reliable
lead times. When others see constraints, we see opportunities to rethink the approach and protect
our customers’ schedules.

As an [**employee-owned company**][16], we are personally invested in every project we support,
because reducing delays, solving complex challenges, and helping our partners succeed isn’t just
part of the job. It’s what sets us apart.

# Who We Serve

**Electrical Contractors** – On-time deliveries, staging, and spec-grade products.

**General Contractors** – Technical insight and product sourcing.

**EPCs and End Users** – Procurement support, compliance expertise, and scalable solutions.

**Consultants** – Dependable equipment and long-term support.

# Why Customers Rely on Access Electric

### **quick ship Products**

Access Electric Supply works closely with industry giants and outside parties alike, enabling us to
deliver innovative and powerful custom package solutions with significantly shorter lead times than
our competitors.

From custom, quick ship switchboards and panelboards to RPPs, PDUs, and more, our quick ship program
is here to help you secure the products you need exactly when you need them.

[learn more about quick ship][17]

### **Technical Expertise backed by results**

With more than 25 years in business and a Top 100 national ranking, Access Electric Supply supports
hundreds of projects across the country every year.

Backed by local inventory, nationwide supplier partnerships, and deep expertise in power and
controls, our team delivers innovative solutions that keep complex builds moving, wherever the work
takes you.

[View Projects][18]

### **Customer Centric Approach**

At Access Electric Supply, we believe great solutions start with strong relationships. Our team
stays hands-on through every phase of a project, listening closely, anticipating challenges, and
ensuring every detail is executed with care.

When you work with us, you’re not just placing an order; you’re partnering with people who know your
goals, understand your pressures, and are committed to delivering success.

[get to know the team][19]

# Solutions for Every Sector

For the second year in a row, we’ve placed in the top 5 nationwide for sales-per-employee. Read more
about this accomplishment [here][20].

**One year ago, we opened the doors to our new warehouse.**

Check out a summary of our first year in Kent [in 60 seconds.][21]

We’re movin’ on up! This year we jumped from 85th to 68th in EW’s top distributors nationwide. Read
more about it [here][22].

## It’s Electric! ⚡️

We’ve added an EV delivery van to our fleet. Come on a joy ride and learn a little more about why we
decided to make this move.

# FAQs

### How can procurement strategy impact project schedule?

Procurement decisions can affect everything from equipment lead times to energization milestones.
Releasing long-lead equipment early, standardizing vendor selections, and coordinating procurement
activities can help improve schedule certainty.

### What are some of the most common causes of electrical project delays?

Long-lead equipment constraints, delayed procurement releases, fragmented supply chain ownership,
vendor changes, and extended submittal cycles can all impact project schedules.

### How can project teams reduce procurement risk?

Many organizations reduce risk by securing production capacity earlier, standardizing equipment
selections, and taking a more proactive approach to procurement planning.

### How can a distributor help simplify complex projects?

A strategic distribution partner can help coordinate manufacturers, contractors, and integrators
while managing long-lead equipment and responding quickly to design changes or supply chain
disruptions.

## **Ready to Power Your Next Project?**

From early planning to project closeout, you need more than a distributor; you need a partner who
understands the demands of complex jobs. Access Electric Supply provides timely, reliable solutions
for everything from routine orders to large-scale system designs.

**Electrical Contractors** – On-time deliveries, staging, and spec-grade products.

**General Contractors** – Technical insight and product sourcing.

**EPCs and End Users** – Procurement support, compliance expertise, and scalable solutions.

**Consultants** – Dependable equipment and long-term support.

# Why Customers Rely on Access Electric

### **quick ship Products**

Access Electric Supply works closely with industry giants and outside parties alike, enabling us to
deliver innovative and powerful custom package solutions with significantly shorter lead times than
our competitors.

From custom, quick ship switchboards and panelboards to RPPs, PDUs, and more, our quick ship program
is here to help you secure the products you need exactly when you need them.

[learn more about quick ship][17]

### **Technical Expertise backed by results**

With more than 25 years in business and a Top 100 national ranking, Access Electric Supply supports
hundreds of projects across the country every year.

Backed by local inventory, nationwide supplier partnerships, and deep expertise in power and
controls, our team delivers innovative solutions that keep complex builds moving, wherever the work
takes you.

[View Projects][18]

### **Customer Centric Approach**

At Access Electric Supply, we believe great solutions start with strong relationships. Our team
stays hands-on through every phase of a project, listening closely, anticipating challenges, and
ensuring every detail is executed with care.

When you work with us, you’re not just placing an order; you’re partnering with people who know your
goals, understand your pressures, and are committed to delivering success.

[get to know the team][19]

# Solutions for Every Sector

For the second year in a row, we’ve placed in the top 5 nationwide for sales-per-employee. Read more
about this accomplishment [here][20].

**One year ago, we opened the doors to our new warehouse.**

Check out a summary of our first year in Kent [in 60 seconds.][21]

We’re movin’ on up! This year we jumped from 85th to 68th in EW’s top distributors nationwide. Read
more about it [here][22].

## It’s Electric! ⚡️

We’ve added an EV delivery van to our fleet. Come on a joy ride and learn a little more about why we
decided to make this move.

# FAQs

### How can procurement strategy impact project schedule?

Procurement decisions can affect everything from equipment lead times to energization milestones.
Releasing long-lead equipment early, standardizing vendor selections, and coordinating procurement
activities can help improve schedule certainty.

### What are some of the most common causes of electrical project delays?

Long-lead equipment constraints, delayed procurement releases, fragmented supply chain ownership,
vendor changes, and extended submittal cycles can all impact project schedules.

### How can project teams reduce procurement risk?

Many organizations reduce risk by securing production capacity earlier, standardizing equipment
selections, and taking a more proactive approach to procurement planning.

### How can a distributor help simplify complex projects?

A strategic distribution partner can help coordinate manufacturers, contractors, and integrators
while managing long-lead equipment and responding quickly to design changes or supply chain
disruptions.

## **Ready to Power Your Next Project?**

From early planning to project closeout, you need more than a distributor; you need a partner who
understands the demands of complex jobs. Access Electric Supply provides timely, reliable solutions
for everything from routine orders to large-scale system designs.

Why Aligned

## What Sets Aligned Apart in Data Center Delivery

Your partner to support your growth, delivering innovative infrastructure with an unparalleled
customer experience.

### Community & Education

Data center development strengthens communities through job creation, tax contributions, business
growth, and support for education. By aligning with regional priorities and listening to residents,
we build relationships that last and add value well beyond our campuses.

[Discover More][85]

### Sustainability

Aligned’s sustainability strategy is built to reduce environmental impact, preserve vital resources,
and create efficient, livable spaces for future generations. From the start, we’ve been dedicated to
addressing the toughest challenges tied to data center infrastructure, energy demand, and water use.

[Discover More][86]

### Innovative Cooling & Adaptive Design

Cooling technology plays a major role in how data centers use water and energy. Aligned uses
air‑cooled, closed‑loop cooling systems that significantly limit ongoing water consumption compared
to legacy designs. Aligned’s adaptive platform is built to scale efficiently while reducing strain
on local resources.

[Discover More][87]

### Operational Excellence & Safety

Data centers are designed to operate as secure, quiet, and low‑traffic neighbors once construction
is complete. Aligned incorporates sound mitigation, safety systems, and proactive coordination with
local utilities and emergency responders to support preparedness and transparency. Operational
excellence ensures reliable digital infrastructure while minimizing impacts on surrounding
communities.

Why Aligned

## What Sets Aligned Apart in Data Center Delivery

Your partner to support your growth, delivering innovative infrastructure with an unparalleled
customer experience.

### Community & Education

Data center development strengthens communities through job creation, tax contributions, business
growth, and support for education. By aligning with regional priorities and listening to residents,
we build relationships that last and add value well beyond our campuses.

[Discover More][85]

### Sustainability

Aligned’s sustainability strategy is built to reduce environmental impact, preserve vital resources,
and create efficient, livable spaces for future generations. From the start, we’ve been dedicated to
addressing the toughest challenges tied to data center infrastructure, energy demand, and water use.

[Discover More][86]

### Innovative Cooling & Adaptive Design

Cooling technology plays a major role in how data centers use water and energy. Aligned uses
air‑cooled, closed‑loop cooling systems that significantly limit ongoing water consumption compared
to legacy designs. Aligned’s adaptive platform is built to scale efficiently while reducing strain
on local resources.

[Discover More][87]

### Operational Excellence & Safety

Data centers are designed to operate as secure, quiet, and low‑traffic neighbors once construction
is complete. Aligned incorporates sound mitigation, safety systems, and proactive coordination with
local utilities and emergency responders to support preparedness and transparency. Operational
excellence ensures reliable digital infrastructure while minimizing impacts on surrounding
communities.

[Discover More][88]

### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

# APL, expert en data centers

Fondée en 1983, APL est une société de conseil et d’ingénierie spécialisée dans la conception et
réalisation de data centers.
Nos services s’articulent autour de quatre activités : conseil et ingénierie data center, conseil et
ingénierie IT,
maintenance et exploitation, numérique responsable.

Créer des data centers en symbiose avec leur environnement, pour que la multiplication des usages
numériques et des data centers qui les soutiennent soient compatibles durablement avec le
développement de nos cités.

Fondée en 1983, APL est une société de conseil et d’ingénierie spécialisée dans la conception et
réalisation de data centers.

ingénierie IT,

# Formation IA pour les entreprises : boostez vos performances

Dans un contexte où la transformation digitale impose l’adoption de l’intelligence artificielle,
BusinessDigital.fr propose des formations sur mesure pour les TPE et PME. Nos programmes, certifiés
Qualiopi, permettent aux équipes de gagner en autonomie, d’optimiser leurs processus et de réduire
les coûts de licences logicielles. Toutes les formations sont éligibles au financement à 100 % par
les OPCO, ce qui simplifie la mise en œuvre pour l’entreprise. Bénéficiez d’un accompagnement
complet, du diagnostic initial à la certification finale, pour intégrer rapidement des solutions IA
souveraines et conformes au AI Act.

## Nos formations

### Agents IA et automatisation des processus

En 28 heures réparties sur quatre jours, cette formation équipe chaque profil métier des compétences
nécessaires pour créer, déployer et piloter des agents IA capables d’automatiser les processus clés
de l’entreprise. Les participants apprennent à identifier les tâches répétitives, à concevoir des
flux d’orchestration et à assurer le suivi opérationnel des agents. Le résultat est une réduction
mesurable du temps de traitement et une libération des ressources humaines pour des activités à plus
forte valeur ajoutée.

### IA pour la logistique et la supply chain

Ce module de 21 heures, organisé sur trois jours, s’adresse aux acteurs de la supply chain qui
souhaitent tirer parti de l’intelligence artificielle pour améliorer la visibilité et la réactivité
de leurs opérations. Les apprenants maîtrisent les modèles prédictifs qui anticipent les ruptures de
stock, optimisent les itinéraires de transport et ajustent les niveaux de sécurité. La formation
inclut des exercices pratiques sur des jeux de données réels, afin que chaque participant repart
avec des algorithmes immédiatement opérationnels.

### IA pour la production industrielle

Destinée aux responsables de production, cette session de trois jours (21 heures) permet d’intégrer
l’IA dans les lignes de fabrication. Les participants apprennent à identifier les cas d’usage
pertinents, notamment la maintenance prédictive, le contrôle qualité automatisé et l’optimisation
des réglages machines. Le programme combine théorie et ateliers pratiques, garantissant que chaque
intervenant puisse piloter un projet IA dès la fin de la formation, tout en respectant les exigences
de conformité et de sécurité industrielle.

### Fine-tuning de modèles LLM en entreprise

Conçue pour les data scientists et les ingénieurs ML, cette formation technique de 28 heures
réparties sur quatre jours couvre le fine‑tuning des modèles de langage open source afin de répondre
aux besoins spécifiques de chaque entreprise. Les participants découvrent les meilleures pratiques
de pré‑traitement, d’ajustement d’hyper‑paramètres et d’évaluation de performances. Ils repartent
avec un modèle LLM personnalisé, prêt à être intégré dans les solutions internes, tout en
garantissant la souveraineté des données.

### IA pour le service client

En deux jours (14 heures), cette formation permet aux équipes du service client de maîtriser les
outils d’IA générative pour automatiser la prise en charge des demandes. Les apprenants conçoivent
des agents conversationnels capables de comprendre, catégoriser et répondre aux requêtes courantes,
tout en conservant une expérience client fluide. Le cours met l’accent sur la mise en production
sécurisée et la mesure de l’impact sur les indicateurs de satisfaction et de productivité.

## Financement OPCO

Le financement OPCO rend chaque formation entièrement prise en charge, sans avance de frais pour
l’entreprise. Les OPCO concernés , Atlas, AKTO, OPCO EP, AFDAS et OPCO 2i , peuvent financer jusqu’à
100 % du coût pédagogique dès lors que le projet de formation est inscrit dans le plan de
développement des compétences. La démarche se déroule en trois étapes : établir le devis détaillé,
le transmettre à l’OPCO choisi, puis obtenir l’accord de prise en charge. Une fois l’accord reçu,
l’organisme de formation facture directement l’OPCO, ce qui simplifie la gestion administrative pour
le client.

## Questions fréquentes

### Qui peut s’inscrire à ces formations IA ?

Toutes les personnes actives dans une entreprise, quel que soit leur niveau d’expérience, peuvent
s’inscrire. Les programmes sont adaptés à chaque métier : fonctions opérationnelles, ingénierie,
logistique, production ou service client. Aucun prérequis technique n’est obligatoire, sauf pour le
module de fine‑tuning qui nécessite des bases en data science.

### Quel est le prérequis nécessaire pour la formation Fine‑tuning de modèles LLM ?

Les participants doivent disposer de connaissances de base en programmation (Python) et d’une
compréhension des concepts de machine learning. Une expérience antérieure avec des modèles de
langage est un atout, mais la formation inclut un rappel des fondamentaux pour garantir que chaque
apprenant puisse suivre le cours en autonomie.

###

### Agents IA et automatisation des processus

En 28 heures réparties sur quatre jours, cette formation équipe chaque profil métier des compétences

de l’entreprise. Les participants apprennent à identifier les tâches répétitives, à concevoir des

de pré‑traitement, d’ajustement d’hyper‑paramètres et d’évaluation de performances. Ils repartent
avec un modèle LLM personnalisé, prêt à être intégré dans les solutions internes, tout en
garantissant la souveraineté des données.

En deux jours (14 heures), cette formation permet aux équipes du service client de maîtriser les
outils d’IA générative pour automatiser la prise en charge des demandes. Les apprenants conçoivent
des agents conversationnels capables de comprendre, catégoriser et répondre aux requêtes courantes,

sécurisée et la mesure de l’impact sur les indicateurs de satisfaction et de productivité.

veri merkezleri kurmak, nesnelerin internetinin olanaklarından faydalanmak isteyenler ve farklı
endüstri alanları için yenilikçi çözümler sunuyoruz…

**Gücümüz**

Canovate Elektronik olarak gelecek vizyonumuz, çözümcül bakış açımız ve AR-GE’ye yaptığımız
yatırımlarımız ile teknolojide ilklere imza atıyoruz. Bu başarımızda tutkulu, bilgili, deneyimli
kadromuzun, ileri uzmanlık düzeyimizin ve çözüm ortaklarımızın rolü çok büyük.

**Hedefimiz**

Yeni ve entegre çözümlerimiz ile hızlı, yenilikçi ve verimli teknolojiler içeren hizmetler sunmayı
ve farklı endüstri alanlarında teknolojimizle dünya çapında rol üstlenmeyi hedefliyoruz.

### Veri Merkezleri

Teknoloji alanında farklı sektörlere inovatif, özgün, sonuç odaklı, fark yaratan ürün ve çözümler!

### Fiber Optik Altyapısı

Biz geleceğin teknolojisini değil, teknolojinin geleceğini üretiyoruz.

### Yapısal Kablolama

İdeal, entegre, esnek ve uçtan uca Yapısal Kablolama Çözümleri Canovate Elektronik’te…

### Rack Kabinetler


Gelişmekte olan dünyada "bilgi" şu anda en değerli varlıktır.

[ [Canovate Tanıtım Video] ][65]

### CANOVATE’e HOŞ GELDİNİZ

## **İhtiyaçları Belirliyor, Hayal Ediyor, Teknolojilerini Yaratıyoruz!**

Dünyanın dününü, bugününü ve yarınını belirleyen, dönüştüren ve değiştiren teknoloji insanlığın en
büyük güçlerinden biri ve olağanüstü bir hızla ilerliyor! Teknoloji üretenler, yeniliklere imza
atanlar dünyamızı, hayatımızı şekillendiriyor. Nesnelerin interneti, endüstri 4.0 uygulamaları, 5G
teknolojisi, dijitalleşme, big data ve yapay zeka çalışmaları geleceğe damgasını vuruyor…

**Dünyanın en iyi 10 global şirketinden biriyiz:**
1979 yılından bu yana bilginin, teknolojinin, AR-GE’nin gücüne inanarak çıktığımız yolda, teknoloji
ve ürün portföyü açısından dünyanın en iyi 10 global şirketinden biri olmaktan gurur duyuyoruz. 40
bin metrekarelik modern üretim tesisimiz, yüksek kalitedeki üretim standartlarımız, farklı endüstri
alanları için bini aşkın geniş ürün yelpazemiz ile dört kıtada faaliyet gösteriyoruz.

## About Us

Catalyst Connection is a private not-for-profit organization headquartered in Pittsburgh,
Pennsylvania. We provide consulting and training services to small manufacturers in southwestern
Pennsylvania, accelerating revenue growth and improving productivity. Through active collaboration
with our clients and the manufacturing community, we contribute to the growth, vibrancy, and ongoing
robustness of manufacturing in our region.

[ Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/about-us/ ][56]
[People Icon]

### People

Catalyst Connection has developed services that can put any manufacturer on the right track to
successful Organizational Development.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/people/ ][57]
[Products Icon]

### Products

Increase your profitability and top-line growth by securing new customers in existing markets,
entering new markets, and successfully developing new products to sustain competitive advantage.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/products/ ][58]
[Process Icon]

### Process

Catalyst has identified the following approaches that successful manufacturers use to further their
journey toward Operational Excellence.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/process/ ][59]
[Technology Icon]

### Technology

Technologies like additive manufacturing, robotics, and digital manufacturing and design are
equipping today’s manufacturers to take their operational performance to the next level.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/technology/ ][60]
[Advanced Manufacturing]

## Case Studies

Manufacturing companies continue working with us because our only focus is creating positive
results. Over the past three decades, we’ve helped thousands of manufacturers across our 12-county
region significantly reduce their costs while improving profitability and increasing revenue. To
find out how manufacturers like yourself can gain real marketplace advantages by working with us,
take a look at our latest case studies from our service areas focused on improving manufacturers
through their People, Products, Processes and Technology.
* [Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/case-studies/ ][61]

[Operational Excellence]

There are a number of grants and programs manufacturers can take advantage of in order to stay
globally competitive.

[Manufacturing Consulting]

## About Us

Catalyst Connection is a private not-for-profit organization headquartered in Pittsburgh,
Pennsylvania. We provide consulting and training services to small manufacturers in southwestern
Pennsylvania, accelerating revenue growth and improving productivity. Through active collaboration
with our clients and the manufacturing community, we contribute to the growth, vibrancy, and ongoing
robustness of manufacturing in our region.

[ Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/about-us/ ][56]
[People Icon]

### People

Catalyst Connection has developed services that can put any manufacturer on the right track to
successful Organizational Development.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/people/ ][57]
[Products Icon]

### Products

Increase your profitability and top-line growth by securing new customers in existing markets,
entering new markets, and successfully developing new products to sustain competitive advantage.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/products/ ][58]
[Process Icon]

### Process

Catalyst has identified the following approaches that successful manufacturers use to further their
journey toward Operational Excellence.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/process/ ][59]
[Technology Icon]

### Technology

Technologies like additive manufacturing, robotics, and digital manufacturing and design are
equipping today’s manufacturers to take their operational performance to the next level.

[Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/services/technology/ ][60]
[Advanced Manufacturing]

## Case Studies

Manufacturing companies continue working with us because our only focus is creating positive
results. Over the past three decades, we’ve helped thousands of manufacturers across our 12-county
region significantly reduce their costs while improving profitability and increasing revenue. To
find out how manufacturers like yourself can gain real marketplace advantages by working with us,
take a look at our latest case studies from our service areas focused on improving manufacturers
through their People, Products, Processes and Technology.
* [Learn More Visit https://www.catalystconnection.org/case-studies/ ][61]

[Operational Excellence]

There are a number of grants and programs manufacturers can take advantage of in order to stay
globally competitive.

** No need to tie yourself and your work to a particular workdesk. Explore beyond your office
premises. Because cloud hosting services are internet-operated, you can roam freely and yet stay in
touch with work. So, no matter where you are, as long as you have access to the internet, you have
access to your cloud server. **

### Collaboration

** The best cloud server feature that providers have long touted is the eased collaboration. People
from different locations can easily work on a common platform and share & update files in real-time.
This allows you to keep track of your work better, and in a convenient manner, with no conflicts
arising due to varied file versions. **

### Cheap, yet Best Cloud Hosting

** Because you are paying less does not at all mean there is a compromise on quality. Why cloud
hosting services are so cheap then? Because they have been built that way. In cloud data centers
virtualization is achieved on a massive scale, with million gigabytes of storage space, allowing

# Data Centers
# Done Differently

We deliver hyperscale campuses built to last. Our industrialized model brings predictability,
consistency and reliable performance to every market – supported by long-standing partners and a
commitment to the communities we’re part of.

[Exterior view of the Compass Datacenters Leesburg, Virginia campus with a team member onsite.]
[Aerial view of the Compass Datacenters campus in Red Oak, Texas.]
[Workers guiding a precast concrete section into place during data center construction.]

## A Manufacturing Mindset For Hyperscale Growth

Standardized, efficient construction that scales with demand.

A consistent, scalable design.
[Interior view of a Compass Datacenters data hall under construction.]

Rather than treating each build as a one-off project, Compass uses a consistent design across all
campuses. This standardization ensures control over the variables that matter most: cost, quality,
schedule and long-term operability – while enabling fungibility across regions. Components, crews
and capacity can be shifted as needed to keep hyperscaler roadmaps on track.

Off-site prefabrication for faster, more predictable delivery
[Workers installing a precast concrete panel during data center construction.]

With ˜85% of each data center manufactured off-site using a standard kit-of-parts, Compass removes
the risks of stick-built construction. The result: faster, more predictable delivery with fewer
surprises and the ability to redirect resources between markets when demand spikes.

Quality and efficiency built-in
[Team member reviewing predictive analytics data inside a Compass Datacenters data hall.]

Factory environments mean fewer errors, less rework and delays on-site.  Every component arrives
tested, refined and ready – driving consistent quality and more cost-efficient outcomes at scale.

Safety-first construction
[Construction worker wearing safety gear conducting an inspection inside a facility.]

By shifting complex, high-risk tasks into controlled factory settings, Compass minimizes heavy
lifting and elevated work on-site – making our campuses safer from day one. This approach also
creates predictable schedules and steady work for local crews, contributing to a more stable and
inclusive workforce.

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

## Cooler Master ESG

reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

finance, conçoit, construit et opère ses propres data centers.

* Des solutions agiles et évolutives : de l’hébergement d’une simple baie à un bâtiment dédié

# We Do Data Centers

[ LEARN MORE ][24]

## Leading Data Center Investment Platform

Developing Data Centers that are designed with the future in mind and following high standards is
our mission. As developers and long-term co-investors, we are committed to setting new benchmarks in
the Data Center market through innovative solutions and exceptional creative execution.

Our approach goes beyond seeking our own success. We focus on creating Data Centers that deliver
sustainable added value for everyone involved. Our solutions are designed to positively shape the
future, with a strong commitment to societal and environmental responsibility. We at Data Center
Partners thrive for change with added value.

# Company

## ABOUT US

### LEADING DATA CENTER INVESTMENT PLATFORM

We are the leading Data Center investment platform in the DACH region (Germany, Austria and
Switzerland). As a full-service provider, we perform the entire range of development- and investment
services along the value-added chain. We are acting as minority joint venture partner as well as
Operating partner.

We see ourselves as innovators, turning the challenges of digitalization in the Data Center industry
into significant opportunities for both ourselves and our investors. To this end, we contribute our
entire professional know-how as well as our many years of experience and the foresight developed
from it. In this way, we create solutions that drive us forward in the long term together with our
investors and stakeholders in order to achieve sustainable added value.

[ learn more ][25]

# Services

## Full SERVICE PROVIDER

### We cover the entire value chain

As a full-service provider, we manage the entire spectrum of Data Center project services across the
entire value chain: From planning and development to construction, leasing, operations, security,
investment, and consulting, we offer comprehensive support. We position ourselves as the one-stop
shop for all your Data Center development and investment projects.

[ learn more ][26]

# Locations

## Find us across europe

### Historical Industry-Mix across all development vehicles

At Data Center Partners, we take an industry-agnostic approach to investments, confident that the
right team can unlock and enhance value in Data Center developments.

Our Data Center activities have primarily focused on the DACH region. Each Data Center project we’ve
undertaken represents a unique story, whether it’s in the planning stages, actively under
development, or fully completed.

[ learn more ][27]

# Investors

## Investment Expertise

### RESPONSIBLE INVESTMENTS IN DATA CENTERS BY MITIGATING RISKS

We are an independent development and investment platform specializing in Data Centers. We not only
invest significant amounts of our own capital directly into Data Centers but also co-invest
alongside our partners, serving as both minority joint venture as well as operating partner.

Our partners include private equity firms, infrastructure funds, family offices, and real estate
companies, all of whom trust our approach to responsible and strategic investments.

[ learn more ][28]

# ESG

## RESPONSIBILITY

### MAKING A POSITIVE CONTRIBUTION

Our mission is to create a sustainable future by driving the growth of digital infrastructure, with
a strong focus on Data Centers. We recognize the significant responsibility we hold towards our
investors, their employees and families, local communities, suppliers, customers, the environment,
and society at large.

We believe that proactive ESG engagement throughout the investment process not only benefits society
but also enhances valuations and delivers superior investment outcomes. Our Sustainability Framework
is the foundation of our ESG strategy, guiding us to build sustainable Data Centers and ensuring
each investment contributes positively.

[ learn more ][29]

future, with a strong commitment to societal and environmental responsibility. We at Data Center
Partners thrive for change with added value.

# Company

## ABOUT US

### LEADING DATA CENTER INVESTMENT PLATFORM

We are the leading Data Center investment platform in the DACH region (Germany, Austria and
Switzerland). As a full-service provider, we perform the entire range of development- and investment
services along the value-added chain. We are acting as minority joint venture partner as well as
Operating partner.

We see ourselves as innovators, turning the challenges of digitalization in the Data Center industry
into significant opportunities for both ourselves and our investors. To this end, we contribute our
entire professional know-how as well as our many years of experience and the foresight developed
from it. In this way, we create solutions that drive us forward in the long term together with our
investors and stakeholders in order to achieve sustainable added value.

[ learn more ][25]

# Services

## Full SERVICE PROVIDER

### We cover the entire value chain

As a full-service provider, we manage the entire spectrum of Data Center project services across the
entire value chain: From planning and development to construction, leasing, operations, security,
investment, and consulting, we offer comprehensive support. We position ourselves as the one-stop
shop for all your Data Center development and investment projects.

[ learn more ][26]

# Locations

## Find us across europe

### Historical Industry-Mix across all development vehicles

At Data Center Partners, we take an industry-agnostic approach to investments, confident that the
right team can unlock and enhance value in Data Center developments.

Our Data Center activities have primarily focused on the DACH region. Each Data Center project we’ve
undertaken represents a unique story, whether it’s in the planning stages, actively under
development, or fully completed.

[ learn more ][27]

# Investors

## Investment Expertise

### RESPONSIBLE INVESTMENTS IN DATA CENTERS BY MITIGATING RISKS

We are an independent development and investment platform specializing in Data Centers. We not only
invest significant amounts of our own capital directly into Data Centers but also co-invest
alongside our partners, serving as both minority joint venture as well as operating partner.

Our partners include private equity firms, infrastructure funds, family offices, and real estate
companies, all of whom trust our approach to responsible and strategic investments.

[ learn more ][28]

# ESG

## RESPONSIBILITY

### MAKING A POSITIVE CONTRIBUTION

Our mission is to create a sustainable future by driving the growth of digital infrastructure, with
a strong focus on Data Centers. We recognize the significant responsibility we hold towards our
investors, their employees and families, local communities, suppliers, customers, the environment,
and society at large.

We believe that proactive ESG engagement throughout the investment process not only benefits society
but also enhances valuations and delivers superior investment outcomes. Our Sustainability Framework
is the foundation of our ESG strategy, guiding us to build sustainable Data Centers and ensuring
each investment contributes positively.

About

## Data Center Map

Launched in 2007, Data Center Map was the first research tool of its kind. We operate a global data
center directory, mapping data center locations worldwide. Our intention is to make it easier for
buyers, sellers, investors, regulators and other professionals working with the industry to gain
insights into the markets of their interest.

## Colocation, Cloud and Connectivity

We cover a wide range of data center services, but our primary focus is colocation, cloud and
connectivity. Our scope extends further, offering insights and statistics on hyperscalers, edge
computing, AI, real estate, network carriers, cloud operators or other digital infrastructure, Data
Center Map is the resource you need.

[Data Center Database][5][Cloud Provider Database][6][Internet Exchange Database][7]

## Procurement & Search Tools

We aim to make it easier for buyers to identify and connect with suitable providers/operators. You
can use our platform to do your own research and contact operators directly. Alternatively, we can
assist with obtaining quotes or guide you through the entire process, from understanding your needs
to finding and engaging with matching providers.

[Get Quotes][8][Free Consultation][9][Data Center Promotions][10]

## Data & Intelligence

We have been tracking the industry since 2007, building one of the most comprehensive databases
available featuring data center locations. We cover power capacity, sizing and many other aspects
relating to supply and demand. If you are looking for a dataset to support your decisions, reach out
to learn more about our datasets available in a wide range of formats (CSV, GeoJSON, KMZ, Shape/SHP)
for integration with your own GIS tools or databases.

[Datasets: Database Exports][11]

## Reach In-Market Buyers

As thousands of visitors are using our database to research colocation, cloud and connectivity
daily, we are a leading channel available for reaching in-market buyers of data center services. We
offer banner advertising, sponsorships, content marketing, enhanced memberships and much more.

## Explore the 2026 Welcome Guide

Welcome to Data Center World 2026! As the world’s largest data center conference and expo, Data
Center World represents the epicenter of industry insight, real-world expertise, cutting-edge
innovation and access to a full spectrum of solution providers driving the data center and digital
infrastructure industry forward.

This Insider’s Guide is key to making the most of your event experience. Inside, you’ll find
everything you need to plan your schedule, book meetings, and dive into key insights.

Let’s make it an unforgettable week for the data center industry!

[View Welcome Guide][65]

## Engage with 450+ Solution Providers Under One Roof

**Find Solutions for Your Challenges at the World's Largest Data Center Expo**

As disruptive technologies such as cloud, edge computing and IoT drive rapid change across all
sectors, the data center remains at the core of business infrastructure.

Data Center World's Expo Hall is the ***only*** place to find the key data center technology
providers displaying their solutions in one location. Network with leading solution providers and
uncover all the latest technologies, products and services your company needs.

## 2026 Omdia Analyst Summit:
## **The Trillion Dollar AIDC Boom: From Megaclusters and Microgrids to the Moon**

**Monday, April 20, 2024 **|** 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM**
**Analyst insight into AIDC opportunities, breakthroughs and bottlenecks. **

As data center investments surpass $1 trillion in 2026, the Omdia Analyst Summit at DCW 2026 is your
opportunity to explore how AI is transforming the industry. From installing increasingly bigger GPU
clusters to meet the growing demand for AI, to the rise of microgrid projects addressing power
challenges, Omdia analysts will provide you with independent data-driven insights into the full
technology stack powering today’s data centers.

***An All-Access, Industry Conference Pass, or AFCOM Solution Provider pass is required to
attend.***

[Discover More About the 2026 Summit][68]

## Data Center World Global Expansion

Building on the success of our flagship U.S. conference, the Data Center World **p****ortfolio will
now expand into Asia, Australia, Brazil, and Europe**, creating a global platform to showcase the
next generation of data center innovation, education, and collaboration.

The expanded lineup reflects the accelerating worldwide demand for digital infrastructure, driven by
AI adoption, cloud growth, sustainability initiatives, and surging data consumption. Each regional
event will deliver Data Center World’s signature combination of expert-led education, strategic
insights and access to best-in-class technology providers throughout the world.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,

## Unlock what matters most.

From unstructured data to unseen value, we help you protect, connect, and activate information to
tackle your most critical business challenges.
[backside of IM worker unpacking truck]
[old media film wrapped like a wheel]
[portrait of IM worker with files]

### Inventory management and logistics

Go from information to intelligence with our global inventory management and logistics services.
From records management to media services to fine art and consumer storage, discover why we’ve been
a trusted partner since 1951.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Records and document storage][274]|[Smart records cleanup suite][275]|[Iron Mountain Warehousing
and Logistics][276]|[Media and entertainment services][277]
[Learn more][278]
[close up of wires in IM data center in arizona]
[Data Centers employee on a tablet]
[Data Centers Phoenix AZP-2 colocation]

### Data center solutions

Protect, connect, and activate your data with our global infrastructure solutions. With 30+ data
centers across 3 continents, explore how you can expand your footprint and join our 1,300+ customers
around the world, including highly regulated organizations & leading global hyperscalers.

**Featured services and solutions:**
[Data centers][279]|[Data centers locations][280]
[Learn more][281]
[an employee working on server in dark, illuminated by laptop light]
[two business people walking outside office building]
[pointing to ai]

### Digital platform and solutions

Don’t just mine your data, manage it. Recognized as a top-20 BPS provider, we combine trusted
information governance with Iron Mountain InSight® DXP, delivering AI-powered insights and workflow
automation across digital and physical content, trusted in 125 countries.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Iron Mountain InSight DXP][282]|[InSight content management][283]|[Information governance advisory
services][284]|[InSight intelligent document processing][285]
[Learn more][286]
[it equipment]
[IM worker packaging IT assets for destruction closeup]
[closeup of IM worker disassembling IT assets]

### IT asset lifecycle management

We’re here to protect your data, drive IT efficiencies, and maximize the return on your IT hardware
investment. As the number one provider of ITAD in North America, we offer end-to-end services, from
deployment to disposition. Explore how we unlock value with a focus on IT reuse.
**Featured services and solutions:**
[Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM)][287]|[Data center decommissioning][288]|[IT asset disposition
(ITAD) ][289]
[Learn more][290]

## Every lap tells a story

The McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team knows that progress isn’t about looking back—it’s about
powering what comes next. We’re proud to partner with McLaren to help make heritage assets
accessible, connecting fans and partners to the stories that shaped the sport.

[Heritage fuels innovation][291]

### Financial services

Digitize your banking and insurance operations.
[Learn More][292]
We work with 46 of the top 50 US banks.
[a healthcare professional in scrubs looking at colleague]

### Healthcare

Reduce complexity, elevate health data access and security, and accelerate digital transformation in
today’s complex healthcare environment.
[Learn More][293]
Our vintage equipment reads 99% of all formats.

### Entertainment and media archives

Keep your assets safe with physical archive storage, asset care, and more.
[Learn More][294]
[library and archives, interior of a modern library]

### Library and archival services

Explore innovative solutions for managing your unique collection.
[Learn More][295]

### Fine arts

State-of-the-art storage facilities for top-notch art preservation.
[Visit Crozier Website][296]
[Crozier employees filling storage container]
220 US agencies are serviced by our public sector team.

### Public sector

Securely store assets and accelerate your digital transformation.
[Learn More][297]

### Small businesses

Enhance operational efficiency, improve customer service, prevent data loss and security breaches
for your business.
[Learn More][298]
80,000 small businesses rely on us for transformation.
[two energy workers pointing at windmills during sunset]

### Energy: oil and gas

By unlocking the power of information, energy companies can accelerate innovation, boost
sustainability, and reduce expenditures.
[Learn More][299]

Go from information to intelligence with our global inventory management and logistics services.
From records management to media services to fine art and consumer storage, discover why we’ve been
a trusted partner since 1951.

Businesses operating in the rapidly transforming digital economy need more than just infrastructure.
They need a strong foundation to build on. Khazna Data Centers is the foundational partner that
helps you drive innovation and growth.

one of the fastest-expanding network of data centers across the region and globally, providing
energy-efficient computing power that tomorrow's workloads need.
When you partner with us, you minimize your capital investment, and gain access to state-of-the-art
facilities specifically designed to open multitude of possibilities for success.

Our solutions blend technical innovation, operations excellence, and sustainability. Khazna is the

# Infrastructure
# for the Future of AI

Uninterrupted. Unmatched. Unstoppable. Multi-gigawatt, behind-the-meter power with full redundancy
keeps hyperscale workloads running at peak speed and reliability. Integrated power, fiber and water
systems give our campuses total infrastructure control at scale.
Multi-Gigawatt
Campus
Pause Video
[X]

## Engineered from the Ground Up

Our site selection process targets power, fiber, and water advantages to maximize performance,
resilience, and scalability.

[Land Selection Power image]

### Power

Behind-the-meter power delivers full energy independence with gas, solar, wind, and redundant
systems for hyperscale AI. Grid-connected yet self-reliant, ensuring uptime, stability, resilience,
and scalable capacity for mission-critical workloads.

[Fiber Image]

### Fiber

Carrier-neutral fiber with diverse, redundant routes to Tier 1 and Tier 2 providers ensures low
latency, high uptime, and scalable bandwidth, keeping mission-critical workloads always online,
resilient, and ready to scale.

[Nexus Ground Water Strategic Land Selection]

### Water

Located above floodplains, our campuses use reclaimed and non-potable water with advanced reuse
systems to minimize environmental impact while ensuring efficient, resilient operations and
uninterrupted performance at scale.

Built Fast. Built Right. Built to Win. Nexus is forging State of the Art hyperscale campuses by
mastering the orchestration of sovereign power, resilient fiber, and sustainable water. In a global
AI race where timing is everything, our proven infrastructure delivery accelerates deployment and
ensures performance from day one.

### 1.Hyperscale AI Campuses

Powered by Nexus’s multi-gigawatt, redundant behind-the-meter infrastructure, grid-connected though
not grid-reliant, our campuses deliver unmatched resilience and energy independence. Built for
future densities and evolving technologies, they accelerate large-scale developments and give
customers a decisive edge in the global AI race.

### 2.Sovereign Power Systems

Downtime isn’t an option. Nexus designs, permits, and builds multi-gigawatt, behind-the-meter power
that delivers energy independence and engineered redundancy. Our natural gas engines, turbines, UPS,
and BESS ensure speed, reliability, and an edge in the AI race.

### 3.Regulatory Leadership

Nexus’s in-house permitting secures all approvals for sovereign, behind-the-meter power and fully
compliant, shovel-ready campuses with speed and precision. Working with TCEQ and local authorities,
we ensure compliance, accelerate timelines, and deliver large-scale data center infrastructure fast
and reliably.

### 4.Redundant Fiber Infrastructure

Low-latency, high-availability connectivity is non-negotiable. Our campus locations are sited to
ensure fully redundant fiber networks, featuring diverse paths and connections to multiple Tier 1
and Tier 2 providers. This carrier-neutral approach ensures continuous uptime and maximum
reliability.

### 5.Sustainable Water Ecosystems

We prioritize sustainable sourcing, reuse, and operational continuity, to minimize environmental
impact while maximizing efficiency. Our commitment to responsible water use ensures that every
campus supports high-performance workloads without burdening local resources.

### 6.Where Uptime Lives

Designed for round-the-clock operations, each campus provides on-site accommodation, dedicated
workshops, and full-time client facilities for 24/7 staff. Offices and amenities are purpose-built
for comfort, efficiency, and performance, enabling continuous innovation and mission-critical
uptime.

## Nexus redefines what it means to build at scale, delivering massive capacity without massive cost
## to communities or ecosystems.

### Built for Impact—Without the Footprint

Sustainability is foundational, not an afterthought. From energy strategy to land use and workforce
development, every campus is designed to deliver meaningful, measurable impact at hyperscale.

[Sustainability Clean Energy]

### Behind the Power

Our campuses run on sovereign, behind-the-meter power, eliminating reliance on local supply.

[sime basioli BRkikoNP0KQ unsplash]

### Water-Conscious Design

We use closed-loop cooling and sustainable non-potable water to operate without municipal supply,
delivering efficient cooling while reducing environmental impact.

[Sustainability Community]

### Community Collaboration

We are committed to being a good neighbor and understanding community needs, working with local
leaders to drive growth and invest in infrastructure and programs that strengthen the community.

### [IOR Service][56]

Worried about your tech deployments in countries where you do not have a legal entity? One Union
Solutions can represent you as **IOR Services** in **190+ countries.** As a global IOR service
provider, we can facilitate your tech deployments worldwide. We have the answer to all your global
worries related to IT and tech deployments. As IOR service provider we take full responsibility for
all your imports from door to data center, without involving the end-user.

[ Inquire Now ][57]

### [Delivered Duty Paid ][58]

**DDP Delivery Service** Incoterms is an agreement comprising the guidelines for the international
transportation of goods. Under the Delivered Duty Paid incoterms, we take full responsibility for
shipment delivery, along with all the risks and costs. These costs include Freight Charges, VAT,
Duties, Import and Custom Liabilities, insurance and any other expenses made until the shipment
arrives at the designated location. With no end-user interaction, we have developed & refined
systems to serve our clients with utmost diligence.

* ## Amaravati (Vijayawada)
  
  ### Data Center Presence
  
  This is Pi’s flagship Hyperscale hub. It is India’s 1st Greenfield and world’s 4th largest Uptime
  Institute-certified Tier IV data center, ensuring design-level modularity, up to 5000 racks with
  60 MW capacity, reliable connectivity, stable operations, and multi-level data protection.
  
  ### Cloud Point of Presence
  
  This location delivers robust private cloud and AI cloud for enterprises across industries, riding
  on its hyperscale Uptime Institute Tier IV certified datacenter ecosystem, boosting service
  availability, scalability, and resilience for enterprises leveraging PiCloud.
* ## Hyderabad
  
  ### Data Center Presence
  
  It is an Uptime Institute Tier III design–compliant, build-to-suit (BTS) facility that leverages
  the city’s robust IT ecosystem, reliable power, and skilled talent to deliver enterprise-grade
  data solutions.
  
  ### Cloud Point of Presence
  
  This rapidly expanding IT & innovation center of the country is the AI cloud point of presence for
  Pi. Businesses are leveraging Pi’s powerful AI framework (Pi STORM), delivering process and cost
  optimization riding on Pi’s scalable GPU clusters to run AI models, training, and operations.
* ## Mumbai
  
  ### Data Center Presence
  
  It is an Uptime Institute Tier III design-compliant data center facility located in India's
  financial capital, offering robust infrastructure with high availability and scalability.
  Strategically positioned near undersea cable landing stations, it ensures strong connectivity,
  enterprise-grade reliability, and secure operations within a high-demand business ecosystem.
  
  ### Cloud Point of Presence
  
  This key business hub is where Pi operates, delivering low-latency access, seamless scalability,
  reliability, and enhanced cloud connectivity. It supports enterprises with integrated cloud
  infrastructure, making it ideal for both primary and disaster recovery (DR) requirements.

MANUFACTURER OF RACKS, CABINETS, PDUs, INTEGRATED CABINETS & PREFABRICATED MODULAR DATA CENTERS

[EXPLORE PDUs][2]

ALL IN ONE CABINET

Rakworx's All-In-One cabinet is meticulously designed for peak efficiency and functionality. It
includes premium features like environmental sensors, electrical systems, natural cooling, security
measures, and monitoring. Ideal for branch offices and remote wiring closets.

[EXPLORE ALL IN ONE][3]

solution with natural air cooling for a PUE as low as 1.1. It's a fully contained, adaptable data
center designed for rapid deployment, scalability, and growth.

[EXPLORE MDCs][4]

needs.

# Speed. Scale. Certainty. Responsibility.

STACK is your trusted digital infrastructure partner, delivering powered land and scalable AI/ML and
cloud density solutions to tackle the largest challenges in an increasingly complex landscape. Our
client-first approach and heightened focus on delivery empowers the world’s most innovative
companies to scale efficiently and sustainably around the globe.

# ENGINEERED FOR AI

[PLAY VIDEO][37]

## WHY DO AI WORLD-FIRSTS HAPPEN AT SWITCH?

For over 20 years, Switch has been designing, building and operating the world’s highest density
data centers. The first SUPERNAP^{®} data center, designed in 2006 by Rob Roy, was an air & liquid
cooling hybrid design built decades before the AI revolution. Rob Roy’s new EVO AI Factories design
has now taken extreme density to unparalleled levels.

**EACH AND EVERY EVO CHAMBER IN OUR AI FACTORIES ARE DESIGNED TO POWER AND COOL MORE THAN 2MW PER
CABINET.**

##### EXASCALE POWER

Modular power density up to gigawatt scale for the world’s most advanced AI workloads.

##### EXASCALE COOLING

Hybrid air & liquid-to-chip cooling for up to 2 megawatts per cabinet distributed from 5 massive
fluidic systems.

##### DIGITAL TWIN

Digitally simulated architecture of AI factories for modeling advanced workloads before real world
deployment.

##### SCALE YOUR AI

Engineered to co-evolve with NVIDIA’s multi-generational GPU roadmap from Blackwell, Rubin and
beyond.

## THE AI, CLOUD & ENTERPRISE DATA CENTER EXPERTS

##### WE ARE UNIQUE IN THE DATA CENTER INDUSTRY

We strive to be a vertically integrated provider of gigawatt-scale data center campuses so that we
may best serve ALL our customers, partners, owners and team members.

##### WE ARE THE MOST ADVANCED

Delivering excellence in design and manufacturing, ease of distribution with an ecosystem approach
and an intelligent capital structure. All while achieving continuous improvements in unit economics
and technology through scale.

# Technology means the world to us.

Sycomp designs and delivers high-performance infrastructure for AI, cloud, and data-intensive
workloads — helping organizations scale innovation without limits.
[
Learn more about Sycomp
][81]

# Data center infrastructure built to scale.

Sycomp plans, designs, and optimizes mission-critical data center operations — helping global
organizations scale, secure, and support sustainable lifecycle management.
[
Explore Data Center Solutions 
][82]

# Endpoint management, built for global teams.

Open-source computing leader trusts Sycomp with seamless device lifecycle management for a fully
remote workforce spanning 60+ countries.
[
Read Case Study

# Expert thinking. Real-world delivery.

Explore Sycomp’s blog for insights on AI infrastructure, cloud operations, and resilient global IT
rollouts.
[
Explore Blog
][84]

# Delivering technology anywhere in the world.

From integration centers to last-mile deployment, Sycomp enables global organizations to move faster
and operate seamlessly across regions.
[
Explore Our Global Advantage
][85]

## We Drive Global Business with technology deployments in 150+ countries

For more than 30 years, Sycomp has worked with top-tier technology partners to get the
difficult-yet-doable done for Fortune 100 companies. Our global IT, logistics and business
specialists have shipped, deployed and managed complex projects just about everywhere – even in
regions with challenging requirements.

With 55+ global locations, including advanced warehouses and integration centers, we handle it all:
currencies, compliance, languages, laws, vendors, resellers, supply chains and Importer of Record
issues – addressing each obstacle and roadblock, every step of the way.

the transfer process needed to be quick, easy, and user-friendly.

Solution

Our team of experts analyzed the customer's challenges and provided tailor-made solutions. This
solution had the ability to read data from the journaling NSF and map it to their respective Office

Solution

tech support staff closely collaborated with the customer to transfer their users to Office 365 and

[a-icon]

#### Scale

We build large-scale campuses (64MW to 1GW+) to enable our customers to grow in place over the long
term.

[a-icon]

#### Speed-to-Market

Proven campus models promote accelerated time-to-market, delivering white space in six months or
less.

[a-icon]

#### Efficiency

Standardized, flexible designs provide predictability, efficiency and non-stop performance.

[a-icon]

#### Sustainability

We partner with our customers to advance technology while remaining good corporate citizens.

[a-icon]

#### Financial Strength

Vantage is backed by a consortium of investors, including DigitalBridge Group, Silver Lake,
AustralianSuper and PSP Investments.

[a-icon]

#### Customer Satisfaction

Our operational excellence, transparency and customer service result in more than 99% of our
customers remaining loyal each year.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
